about_the_game:
This is your story to tell.

​Arcadian Days is a first-person exploration-adventure game that sets free your sense of child-like wonder and joy for the world. Explore highly detailed and vibrant environments packed with secrets, shape a dynamic narrative, develop your homestead and play with your loyal dog companion!

Stories That Unfold Naturally

No two playthroughs are alike: your interactions and observations influence the story and the world:

  • Emergent storytelling: Dive into narratives that unfold naturally, shaped by your actions and discoveries, making every playthrough uniquely personal.

  • Dynamic family relationships: Deepen your bonds with your family through simple, organic interactions. Shape their vocations and future by guiding them towards farming, animal husbandry, or pottery, among many others.

  • Environmental storytelling cues: Have you noticed subtle changes in the landscape? Certain environmental details hint at evolving stories, inviting exploration and keen observation.

With hundreds of narrative possibilities, every playthrough will be different.

Discover a one-of-a-kind world, presented in AAA-level detail

​Embark on a journey through the meticulously crafted world of Arcadian Days:

  • Dynamic Biomes: Traverse five distinct biomes - from a lush forest, expansive hills and climb up towards a fantastic fortress on a step hill - that evolve daily, influenced by both the passage of time and your choices, ensuring a unique experience with each playthrough.​

  • Cultural Immersion: Become part of the Dragobete family and explore their unique customs, traditions, and a unique dialect. As one of them, you’ll gain an authentic glimpse into their way of life.

  • Meticulous design: Explore densely populated maps where every element is thoughtfully placed, promising breathtaking scenery and hidden secrets around every corner.

Explore at Your Own Pace

  • No hard quests. No combat. No frills. Just you, your dog Tola, and a world full of secrets waiting to be uncovered through curiosity, attention, and play.

  • Track Miela's thoughts and discoveries through the 'Story Map' and see where your curiosity takes you. There is no wrong or right path in Arcadian Days.

Minimalist Design for Maximum Immersion

A minimalist interface that allows for a staggering amount of interaction and choice with the world around you. Simple, tactile actions that reflect a child's view of the world—creative, emotional, and free.

name: Arcadian Days

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit required) with DirectX 12
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050Ti / AMD RX 6000 / Intel® Arc™ A550 Graphics Card
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64 bit required) with DirectX 12
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3070 Ti / Nvidia GeForce RTX 4070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Arcadian Days is a non-linear, relaxing game where your choices shape a dynamic world and story. Play as Miela, explore vibrant landscapes, form meaningful relationships, and uncover secrets with your loyal dog, Tola. Each playstyle is unique to you.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Korean, Polish, Romanian, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian
